set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Tracked pkgdown source configuration rebuilds the site.
- All public Rd topics appear or are intentionally excluded.
- Solver guide compares formulation, marginals, regularization, maturity, and performance.
- Experimental and optional APIs are visibly labeled.
- Every flagship solver has a runnable example and diagnostic interpretation.
- Generated-doc consistency runs in CI.
set.title: Regenerate and restructure complete solver documentation
